briefing: CYBER grew the most: its total value went from $15.5M to $21.7M, up 40.4% in 24 hours.
Across the 283 Binance coins worth between $15M and $2B, 234 grew and 48 shrank — a strong day.
Harmony's market cap jumped 54.9%, but its price moved only 51.5% — more coins are now counted in circulation, so the jump didn't come from buyers. We tag these “New supply”.
